views.name: audit_demo
views.definition:
SELECT (record ->> 't'::text) AS t,
    (record ->> 'who'::text) AS who,
    (record ->> 'a'::text) AS a
   FROM demo.audit;

views.name: audit_live
views.definition:
SELECT (record ->> 't'::text) AS t,
    (record ->> 'by'::text) AS by,
    (record ->> 'a'::text) AS a
   FROM live.audit;
